title: CHEESE BALL

steps: Mix cream cheese, cheddar and Worcestershire sauce until smooth. Shape into a ball.
Roll in pecans and chill at least 2 hours before serving.

originalText:
CHEESE BALL Appetizers Aunt Example
1 8-oz pkg cream cheese, softened
1 cup Cheese--Cheddar, shredded
1/2 cup chopped pecans
1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
Mix cream cheese, cheddar and Worcestershire sauce until smooth. Shape into a
ball.
Roll in pecans and chill at least 2 hours before serving.

title: CORNBREAD

steps: Heat oven to 425 degrees and grease an 8-inch square pan.
Stir everything together just until moistened and pour into the pan. Bake 20-25 minutes, until golden.

originalText:
CORNBREAD Breads Grandma Placeholder
1 cup Flour--All Purpose
1 cup corn meal
2 tbsp sugar
1½ cups buttermilk
1 egg
Heat oven to 425 degrees and grease an 8-inch square pan.
Stir everything together just until moistened and pour into the pan. Bake 20-25
minutes, until golden.

title: CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES

steps: Cream butter and both sugars, then beat in the eggs.
Add flour and soda, then stir in the chips. Drop by teaspoons onto a baking sheet and bake at 375 for 9 to 11 minutes.

originalText:
CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES Desserts Cookies Cousin Sample
1 cup butter, softened
3/4 cup sugar
3/4 cup Sugar--Brown, packed
2 eggs
2¼ cups Flour--All Purpose
1 tsp baking soda
1 12-oz bag chocolate chips
Cream butter and both sugars, then beat in the eggs.
Add flour and soda, then stir in the chips. Drop by teaspoons onto a baking sheet
and bake at 375 for 9 to 11 minutes.

title: LEMON POPPY SEED CAKE

steps: Beat cake mix, pudding, eggs, oil and 1 cup water for 2 minutes; stir in the poppy seeds.
Bake in a greased bundt pan at 350 for 45-50 minutes. Mix the glaze and drizzle it over the warm cake.

author: Chef Example
originalText:
LEMON POPPY SEED CAKE Desserts Cakes Chef Example
1 box Cake Mix--Lemon
1 3.4-oz pkg instant lemon pudding
4 eggs
1/2 cup oil
2 tbsp poppy seeds
Glaze:
1 cup Sugar--Powdered
2 tbsp lemon juice
Beat cake mix, pudding, eggs, oil and 1 cup water for 2 minutes; stir in the poppy
seeds.
Bake in a greased bundt pan at 350 for 45-50 minutes. Mix the glaze and drizzle it
over the warm cake.

title: HAMBURGER CASSEROLE

steps: Crumble the beef and onion into a 2-quart dish. Microwave on high 5-6 minutes, stirring once; drain.
SPECIAL SAUCE: Stir the soup with 1/2 cup milk and a dash of pepper until smooth.
Add the noodles and sauce to the beef. Cover and microwave 4 minutes more.

originalText:
HAMBURGER CASSEROLE Main Dishes Casseroles Microwave/Cousin Sample
1 lb ground beef
1 onion, chopped
1 10¾-oz can cream of mushroom soup
2 cups cooked noodles
Crumble the beef and onion into a 2-quart dish. Microwave on high 5-6 minutes,
stirring once; drain.
SPECIAL SAUCE:
Stir the soup with 1/2 cup milk and a dash of pepper until smooth.
Add the noodles and sauce to the beef. Cover and microwave 4 minutes more.

title: LAYERED SALAD

steps: Layer lettuce and peas in a glass bowl, spread mayonnaise over the top to seal, and sprinkle with cheese.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.

originalText:
LAYERED SALADSalads Cousin Sample Make ahead
1 head lettuce, torn
1 cup frozen peas
1 cup mayonnaise
1/2 cup Cheese--Swiss, shredded
Layer lettuce and peas in a glass bowl, spread mayonnaise over the top to seal,
and sprinkle with cheese.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.

title: BROCCOLI BAKE

ingredients.raw: Topping: 1/2 cup cracker crumbs mixed with 2 tbsp melted butter

steps: Put broccoli in a casserole, pour the soup over it, and top with cheese and the crumb topping.
Bake at 350 for 30 minutes.

originalText:

Topping: 1/2 cup cracker crumbs mixed with 2 tbsp melted butter
Put broccoli in a casserole, pour the soup over it, and top with cheese and the
crumb topping.
Bake at 350 for 30 minutes.

title: PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE

steps: Microwave the chips and milk 2 minutes, stir until smooth, add vanilla, and spread in a buttered 8-inch pan.

originalText:
PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE	Desserts	Microwave	Aunt Example
1 12-oz pkg Chips--Peanut Butter
1 14-oz can sweetened condensed milk
1 tsp vanilla

title: SLOW COOKER CHILI

steps: Put everything in a slow cooker and cook on low 6 to 8 hours. Taste and add salt before serving.

author: Chef Example
originalText:
SLOW COOKER CHILI Soups Chef Example Make ahead
1 lb ground beef, browned
2 15-oz cans kidney beans, drained
1 28-oz can crushed tomatoes
1 onion, chopped
2-3 tbsp chili powder
Put everything in a slow cooker and cook on low 6 to 8 hours. Taste and add salt
before serving.
